description: Make Mara examination distinguish an active ladder injury from a healed injury that remains part of her history.

replacements.old:
<COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-INJURY>
                  <TELL " One palm is scraped raw from the Dam ladder, and she is protecting a shoulder that stiffened under the catch.">)>
replacements.new:
<COND (<AND <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-INJURY>
                       <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-RECOVERED>>
                  <TELL " One palm bears the pale rough scar of the Dam ladder; the shoulder that stiffened under the catch is moving freely again.">)
